parsed.notes: The excerpt names the 2024 Credit Agreement's financial covenants: a consolidated interest coverage ratio, a maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio and a maximum consolidated secured leverage ratio. The risk factor section also mentions a minimum adjusted cash EBITDA covenant and a minimum liquidity covenant. It states only that the company was in compliance as of March 31, 2026. No actual ratio values or numeric limits are disclosed. The total net leverage ratio is also used to set the Term SOFR margin (2.50%/2.75%/3.00%; 3.00% as of March 31, 2026). The July 29, 2025 First Amendment kept the existing total net leverage ratio level for the duration of the agreement, but the excerpt does not give that level.
